episode: Episode 1 · Robot vacuums without a camera
title: The Robot That Can't See You
subtitle: Sam wants a robot vacuum this Black Friday. Then Sam reads the news.
end: Which camera-free robot should you buy? Six picks, compared below.

art.prompt: Late at night in a cozy small apartment living room lit by a warm floor lamp and blue moonlight from a big window. Sam sits on a gray sofa grinning at his smartphone, its glow on his face. Biscuit sleeps curled on a round cushion beside him. Medium-wide shot. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Robot vacuums are on sale. Goodbye, dog hair!

art.prompt: Over-the-shoulder close-up in a dark room: Sam's hand holds a smartphone whose screen shows a blurry, grainy photo of someone's living room taken from floor level, as if leaked. The cold screen light contrasts with the dark. Unease. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: 2022: photos taken by test robot vacuums were posted online (MIT Technology Review). 2026: hacked robots showed live camera feeds (Tom's Hardware).

art.prompt: Dramatic extreme close-up of Sam's shocked face, eyes wide, mouth open, sweat drop, intense dramatic lighting from below, radiating manga speed lines in the background. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Wait. My vacuum would have a CAMERA?

art.prompt: Eerie low-angle wide shot at floor level in a dark living room: a sleek white round robot vacuum seen from the front, with a small glowing lens on its front bumper like an eye, looking toward the viewer. Moody blue shadows, a thin beam of light. Thriller atmosphere. The robot is generic and unbranded. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Many robots dodge clutter by photographing it.

art.prompt: Vera makes a confident entrance in a bright, clean space, one hand raised presenting a glowing holographic diagram of a round robot with red laser lines radiating out from a small turret on top. Dynamic pose, wind in her hair, sparkles of light. Heroic, upbeat. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: There's another way: a spinning laser. LiDAR.
It measures distance. It never takes a photo.

art.prompt: A generic white round robot vacuum with a small dark turret on top glides across a dark living room floor at night; thin red laser lines sweep out from the turret across walls and furniture like a lighthouse, beautiful and calm. No camera on the robot. Unbranded. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: It maps your home in the dark. No pictures.

art.prompt: Sam pumps his fist, beaming with relief, in his apartment; Vera stands slightly behind him with arms crossed and a knowing half-smile, one eyebrow raised. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

Dynamic action shot at floor level: a generic white round robot vacuum charges forward across a wooden floor, dragging a black phone charging cable and pushing a red sock, motion blur and speed lines, dust flying, comic energy. Unbranded. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: It scans at the height of its turret. It sees the sofa, not the sock.
Source: CNET, best robot vacuums of 2026 (lab test by Ajay Kumar).

art.prompt: Tense floor-level shot: Biscuit stands frozen with big worried eyes and ears perked as a white round robot vacuum slowly approaches from the right across a wooden floor. Dramatic shallow depth of field, suspense. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: And no camera-free robot in our guide promises to avoid pet waste.

art.prompt: Comedic super-deformed chibi version of Sam panicking, both hands on his head, eyes as huge white circles, tiny body, bright pink background with radiating burst lines. Funny reaction panel. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

Warm moment: Vera kneels on a living-room rug and gently scratches Biscuit behind the ears; the puppy leans into her hand, happy. Soft afternoon light. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

Bright morning sunlight floods the apartment. Sam kneels on the floor coiling a charging cable and picking up a red sock, smiling; Biscuit wags his tail beside him; a white round robot vacuum waits on its dock in the background. Hopeful, warm colors. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Next morning. The 30-second rule: cords and socks off the floor before every run.

art.prompt: Quiet, emotional closing shot from behind: Sam sits on the floor by a big sunny window with Biscuit in his lap, both watching a white round robot vacuum glide across the clean floor. Golden light, peaceful, heartwarming. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: One more thing: a laser robot still sends your floor map to the cloud. Skip the data-sharing program in the app.
